panchrestus (panchristus ), a, um, adj., = πάγχρηστος,
I.good or useful for every thing: “medicamenta,” Plin. 36, 20, 38, § 146 ; 23, 7, 71, § 136.—
II. Transf., ironically: cum omnes ejus comites iste sibi suo illo panchresto medicamento amicos reddidisset, by his sovereign remedy, i. e. money, Cic. Verr. 2, 3, 65, § 152.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
